# The same customer's second invoice, paid the same day, for the same figure,
# into the same account, with the same memo — and its own guid, naming a
# transaction this book does not hold.
#
# One customer settling two invoices with two payments that agree on every
# field a block carries is ordinary: same size, same day, same account, and
# whatever memo the bank line was given. Printed from the book they were made
# in, each block names its own transaction, and read into any other book both
# guids resolve to nothing.
#
# Companion to a_second_invoice_paid_the_same_day.txt, which is the two-owner
# version of the same shape.
customer "C-SPELL"
	name: "Spelling Customer"
	currency: CAD

invoice "INV-SPELL-2"
	customer_id: "C-SPELL"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-01-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-01
		description: "A line"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-01
		due: 2026-01-31
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "Invoice INV-SPELL-2"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-01-15
		amount: 100
		account: "Assets:Bank"
		memo: "Paid"
		txn_guid: "0ff1ce0ff1ce0ff1ce0ff1ce0ff1ce00"
